name: Snow Time

categories.label: Points on score track
categories.hint: Fruit points, fight points and lowest-level point are tracked during play; record the final track position.

endCondition.description: Game ends when a player reaches the end of the score track (exact length not verified).

notes: family: running-track-race. In-play scoring (not itemised): fruit on the level you hold, 1 fight point per defeated opponent, 1 point for the lowest surviving level; special bonus spaces on the track. 2-player variant uses two characters per player. Official rulebook not found online (only scans); length of the track, tiebreaker and exact bonus spaces are unverified, so needsReview.
